title: Workers popup shows the pane queue, with a withdraw key
notes: Second card of the pane pool (95a08d4a, #408, workers-decision-11). The popup lists queued entries under the running workers, in queue order with their position; a row key withdraws one through pane.unqueue (a new row in src/shared/keys/actions.ts, help.ts updated), and the settings screen gets a workers.cap row. Start after #408 merges.

comments.body: Overlaps #411 (card 99b304cb, Split main.ts along its seams, in Review): it rewrites main.ts's sessionRequests({...}) block into sessionRequestPorts(...) in src/main/workers/session-request-ports.ts, including the poolPorts(...) line this card must change to tell the renderer of a queue change; both also edit docs/workers/README.md. main.ts sits at exactly 600 code lines on main, so this card's IPC doors (workers:queue, workers:unqueue) go in a new module either way.
